{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders — they should not count toward conversion rate
sales_df_completed = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check if customer_segment is confounded with channel
# Cross-tabulate customer_segment vs channel
confound_check = pd.crosstab(sales_df_completed['customer_segment'], sales_df_completed['channel'])

# Check if channel affects conversion rate independently
conversion_by_channel = sales_df_completed.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

print("Conversion rates by channel:")
print(conversion_by_channel)
print("\nCross-tabulation of customer_segment vs channel:")
print(confound_check)"}
